name: Tractor Supply
description: Tractor Supply is the largest US rural-lifestyle retailer, with 2,602 stores in 49 states (2,395 Tractor Supply and 207 Petsense) selling feed, pet supplies, fencing, tools, work clothing, seasonal and recreation goods to hobby farmers, ranchers and rural homeowners. Much of what it sells (animal feed, pet food, bedding) is repeat consumable demand tied to livestock and pets, not to housing or fashion. FY2025 sales were $15.5 billion (+4.3 percent), operating margin 9.45 percent and net income $1.10 billion; it pays a rising dividend and buys back stock. It reports one segment.
